parts.gloss: to make glad / to smile (infinitive used adverbially)

literal: Speaking concisely, avoiding disagreeable things, speaking pleasantly, yielding benefit is the mission of an envoy.
translation: To speak concisely, to avoid disagreeable words, and to speak so as to please, thereby yielding a beneficial result, is the true mission of an envoy.
modern: விஷயங்களைச் சுருக்கமாகச் சொல்லி, வெறுப்புத் தரும் சொற்களைத் தவிர்த்து, கேட்பவர் மகிழுமாறு பேசி, நன்மையைத் தருவதே சிறந்த தூது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the essential communication strategy of a successful diplomat. First, the envoy must present the core message concisely to maintain the listener's attention. Second, they must carefully filter out any offensive or disagreeable remarks that could provoke hostility. Third, they must speak in a pleasing, winning manner to foster goodwill. By combining these three qualities, the envoy's speech yields a beneficial outcome for their state.
